messages.text: Tuesday, November 24 · Canton, Michigan
Persian strings, cold iron, and a moon that refuses to wane
The sky holds a full moon above the overcast landscape as we settle into a quiet week. Global sounds in Ann Arbor and local energy policy updates define the current rhythm of our corner of Michigan.
Expect an overcast day with a high of 39 degrees and a low of 24 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:36 AM and sets at 5:05 PM, while the moon remains full and 99.6% illuminated.
Midday music and global sounds
The Stearns Collection Lunchtime Concert Series offers a free performance featuring Persian santour player Alireza Fazel at 12:00 PM in the NCRC Building 18 cafeteria.
A community meeting is scheduled for tomorrow, November 25, at 6:30 PM.
New energy models and research scrutiny

Ann Arbor's Veridian at County Farm is launching a pilot virtual power plant to manage residential solar storage. Meanwhile, a proposed research facility in Ypsilanti Township faces criticism from advocacy groups over its funding and intended use.
Looking toward the week
Prepare for the 862 meeting taking place on the evening of November 25.

Wednesday, November 25 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies and the rhythmic pull of a 250,000-page proof

The day brings a quiet, overcast chill to Canton as the region edges toward a rainy Wednesday. Local focus turns to the intersection of music and storytelling, while global mathematics grapples with an unprecedented AI-assisted milestone.
The day will remain overcast with a high near 43°F and a low of 26°F.
Sunrise is at 7:37 AM, sunset is at 5:05 PM, and the moon is full and 99.2% illuminated.
Mid-week rhythm and resonance
For a local evening, catch the free happy hour performance by guitarist Jordan Smith-Hays at the North Star Lounge in Ann Arbor at 5:30 PM.
An 862 meeting is scheduled for this evening at 6:30 PM.
Construction oversight in Van Buren Township

Wayne County has issued a stop-work order for the Google data center project known as Project Cannoli. The order cites an absence of required county construction permits and potential interference with local drainage infrastructure.
Preparing for Wednesday rain
Expect rain throughout Wednesday as temperatures shift toward a high of 45°F.
